fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. The LORD says He will scatter them “…among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known…” (Jeremiah 9:16). Not just nations they hadn't met, but nations their fathers hadn't known either. That's a whole lot of unfamiliar ground.

Family, friend? I get it, a family brag can go on for ages. But it didn't make this list. The LORD names the wise man in his wisdom, the strong man in his strength and the wealthy man in his riches (Jeremiah 9:23). Three men, three bragging rights, and not one of them is family. Nice swing, though!

SPEECH?! Baker, I love the confidence, I really do. But that word isn't in the verse. The LORD says the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart (Jeremiah 9:26). Heart is the word that goes in the blank, so tuck that one in your apron pocket.
